_comment: EARNED, not aspired to. A profile lands here only after a run proved the number; each raise is a deliberate commit. A profile that is absent prints a baseline and passes — the first measurement of anything must not fail a build.
_keys: '<persona> · <retrieval>'. The retrieval is part of the measurement's identity: while the swap is in flight both paths are measured against the same yardstick, and one shared row would mean ratcheting the better path fails the worse one.

Rupanjana Mitra · feed._note: The floors are 0.00 because that is what the 500-row sample earns: of the 40 listings the yardstick shortlists, NONE can be reached on /market at any page depth. It shows 96 and 69 of them fail the yardstick's own rules. This row exists to be deleted with the feed.

Rupanjana Mitra · rpc._note: Whole-corpus retrieval. 68% of the yardstick is reachable and 35% is shown; the 33% between them is the 2-per-employer cap, where both sides cap at two and disagree on WHICH two — a ranking fault, not a reach one. Every one of the 12 remaining violations has the same single cause: years_experience is NULL for every account older than 2026-09-24, so a mid-band person gets the band's [2,5] instead of her own [2.2,4.2] and roles asking 5 reach the list. The forward pass reads it off her banked CV on her next visit; this number should fall on its own as people return.
